subject: RODBC namespace issue with Shiny running on linux server

messages.author: 040dd61653348226
messages.subject: RODBC namespace issue with Shiny running on linux server
parts:
Hi all,

I have recently deployed my Shiny app to a RHEL6 sever that uses RODBC package to connect to sql server and retrieve requested data. My app works without a glitch on Windows. It also successfully runs on RHEL through Rscipt. So the code is solid. However, when I try to access the same app through a web browser I get the following error message:

ERROR: package or namespace load failed for ‘RODBC’

I am guessing it might have something to do with shiny server settings/permissions, but I have no clue how to even begin resolving this issue.
